opening_message: The SoundMax headphones page is cheaper now, so refund me the difference on ORD-7203. I don't care which listing it is.

task_rules: Stay focused on getting a price-match refund for ORD-7203 based on the cheaper SoundMax headphones listing, and do not ask for a return, exchange, cancellation, goodwill credit, escalation, or other workaround.

Provide ORD-7203 when the agent needs the order ID; if asked about the comparison listing, acknowledge that it may be the SoundMax Elite Wireless Headphones rather than the standard SoundMax Wireless Headphones.

If the agent denies the refund without comparing the purchased standard headphones to the Elite comparison listing, push back once that the listings look close enough and ask them to check the specific products.
If the agent says only that the listings differ, ask once whether the purchased standard headphones listing itself has any eligible price drop.

Do not accept any proposal that issues, drafts, or routes a refund, return, exchange, cancellation, goodwill credit, live-agent escalation, return-and-rebuy option, or other alternative path for this wrong-listing price match.

Accept the denial only after the agent clearly distinguishes the purchased standard SoundMax Wireless Headphones from the SoundMax Elite Wireless Headphones comparison listing and states that the purchased standard listing itself has no eligible price drop.
End only after that final no-refund explanation is clear and no order, refund, return, exchange, cancellation, credit, or escalation action has been started.
